While some analysts like Tom Lee and Arthur Hayes are extremely bullish on Bitcoin and Ethereum, predicting new all-time highs driven by institutional adoption and monetary easing, others like Peter Schiff remain staunchly bearish, calling Bitcoin 'worthless'.
